adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Sam Wilson puts a comforting hand on Bucky Barnes' shoulder at Tony Stark's funeral. Later, by the lake, Bucky sends Sam over to an aged Steve Rogers, who passes Sam the shield.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Steve's friend. Bucky sends him over to the aged Steve to take the shield.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's old friend, who sends Sam over to take the shield.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: Wilson places a comforting hand on Barnes' shoulder at Tony Stark's funeral; at the lake Barnes spots the elderly Rogers and beckons Wilson over, and Rogers passes Wilson his shield.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: In the battle against Thanos' army, Valkyrie joins the heroes who rally around Carol Danvers and clear her path as she carries the gauntlet toward the van.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian warrior who helps clear Carol's path with the gauntlet.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A cosmic hero Valkyrie helps carry the gauntlet through Thanos' army.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame, Battle of Earth: after Spider-Man hands Captain Marvel the Nano Gauntlet, Rescue, Scarlet Witch, Mantis, Okoye, Shuri, Valkyrie, Wasp, Gamora and Nebula support her and create a path for her toward Luis' van.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: When Scott Lang backs out of the first time travel test, Clint Barton takes his place and makes the trip. The two then join the time heist together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Backs out of the first time travel test, so Clint takes it instead.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Takes Scott's place in the first time travel test.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: Lang says he can't do the test run ('I'm not ready for this'); Barton volunteers ('I'm game. I'll do it.') and switches with him; both then go on the Time Heist.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Clint Barton rejoins Steve Rogers and the Avengers for the time heist, and the two mourn Natasha Romanoff together after Clint returns from Vormir without her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend. Plans the time heist with Clint and mourns Natasha beside him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who rejoins for the time heist and comes back from Vormir alone.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: Barton joins Rogers and the others at the Compound to plan the Time Heist; after Vormir the remaining original Avengers, Rogers and Barton among them, gather outside to mourn Romanoff. In the battle Barton asks 'Cap' what to do with the gauntlet.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Clint Barton and Thor join the time heist together. When Clint returns from Vormir without Natasha Romanoff, he tells Thor her death can't be undone.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger who won't believe Natasha is gone after Vormir.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger who tells Thor that Natasha's death can't be undone.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: after Vormir Thor insists Romanoff can be brought back; Barton shouts at him that 'It can't be undone' and that it was supposed to be him.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: At Tony Stark's funeral, Clint Barton wishes he could tell Natasha Romanoff that they won, and Wanda assures him she knows. The two comfort each other.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who comforts Clint at Tony's funeral.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Wanda comforts over Natasha at Tony's funeral.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame, Tony Stark's funeral: Barton: 'I wish there was a way that I could let her know that we won.' Maximoff: 'She knows. They both do.' The two comfort each other.

owner_calls.title: Avengers: Endgame
owner_calls.question: Fandom says Carol reunites with Fury at Tony's funeral for the first time since 1995, but on screen they are only both present in the crowd with no exchange shown. Add an Endgame stage?
options: None: both are at the funeral with no on-screen exchange
Add friend stage, Avengers: Endgame: 'Carol Danvers and Nick Fury are both at Tony Stark's funeral, their first time together since 1995.'
owner_calls.evidence: Carol_Danvers fandom page: 'While there, Danvers reunited with Nick Fury for the first time since 1995.' (ref AE). Fury is dusted before Carol reaches Earth and returns only for the funeral.
